purpose: Teach: 稀/読み方/目先/義父/うるさく/柔らかい/恥ずかしく/嫁さん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、稀、絶対、な、絶対、カード、絶対、引いたな
lines.en: Riku — you definitely pulled a rare card, didn't you?
lines.style: Quick, accusatory energy. Leans forward on the opening. Playful challenge in the rhythm, like she's caught him red-handed and loves it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、この漢字の、本気で、絶対、読み方、絶対、教えてくれよ、桜
lines.en: Hey, can you teach me how to read this kanji, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, a little sheepish. Soft attack. Not demanding — asking a real favor. Ends with a slight lift, like he actually wants the answer.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、目先、絶対、の勝ち、絶対、ばっか追ってんな
lines.en: You're always just chasing whatever wins you can get right now, aren't you?
lines.style: Dry observation delivered with a thin smile. Even pace, almost conversational. The criticism wrapped in fondness — she's seen through him and he knows it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、義父、絶対、って、絶対、何の意味?桜
lines.en: Wait — what does 'father-in-law' even mean, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine confusion, not performed. Stops mid-thought. The question lands like he's truly stuck. Slight urgency — he needs to understand this word specifically.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、うるさく、絶対、しないでよ、図書館、絶対、よ
lines.en: Don't be so loud — we're in the library, seriously.
lines.style: Low, controlled whisper. Firm without heat. A glance around first, then back to him. She means it, but she's not angry — just managing the space they're in.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のクッション、本気で、絶対、柔らかい、絶対、んな、桜
lines.en: Your cushion is really soft, isn't it?
lines.style: Quiet noticing, like he's just discovered something small and pleasant. Genuine appreciation in the tone. Touchable, intimate observation. Not performing surprise.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、本気で、絶対、恥ずかしく、絶対、ても、絶対、頑張れよ
lines.en: Try hard anyway, even if it's embarrassing, okay?
lines.style: Earnest and steady. She's shifting into sincerity now. Slight lean toward him. Not commanding — encouraging. The tone of someone who believes he can do it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の兄貴の、本気で、絶対、嫁さん、絶対、いい人だな、桜
lines.en: Your brother's wife is really a good person, isn't she, Sakura?
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost to himself. Slow, genuine reflection. Warm recognition of goodness. Ends with the name like he's offering her something he's noticed — a small moment of appreciation.
